# UserSubscriptionUpdatedHandler

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.handlers.UserSubscriptionUpdatedHandler`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(callback: Callable, filters = None): ...
```

## Documentation

The UserSubscriptionUpdated handler class. Used to handle changes of the subscriptions of users to the
bot. It is intended to be used with [`add_handler`](../methods/utilities/add_handler.md).

For a nicer way to register this handler, have a look at the
[`on_user_subscription_updated`](../decorators/on_user_subscription_updated.md) decorator.

### Parameters

- **`callback`** (`Callable`)
  Pass a function that will be called when the subscription of a user to the bot changes. It takes
  *(client, user_subscription_updated)* as positional arguments (look at the section below for a
  detailed description).

- **`filters`** (`Filters`)
  Pass one or more filters to allow only a subset of updates to be passed in your callback function.

Other parameters:
    client (`Client`):
        The Client itself, useful when you want to call other API methods inside the handler.

    user_subscription_updated ([`UserSubscriptionUpdated`](../types/bots_and_keyboards/UserSubscriptionUpdated.md)):
        The changed subscription.
